dbo.archive_monthly_reports.summary: Archives monthly reports by reading from dbo.monthly_report and writing to dbo.report_archive.

dbo.build_monthly_report.summary: Generates a monthly report by reading payments and reconciliation data and writing to dbo.monthly_report.

dbo.clean_invoice_records.summary: Cleans invoice records, updates payments, and invokes payment reconciliation.
steps: Read from dbo.clean_invoices, dbo.payment_imports, and dbo.payments.

dbo.dynamic_rate_refresh.summary: Executes dynamic SQL to refresh rates based on dbo.rate_sources.

dbo.load_invoices.summary: Loads invoices from staging into clean invoice tables, logs errors and audits, and triggers cleaning.
steps: Write to dbo.audit_log, dbo.clean_invoices, and dbo.error_log.

dbo.nightly_cleanup.summary: Performs nightly cleanup based on cleanup policies, writing to expired sessions and audit logs.

dbo.reconcile_payments.summary: Reconciles payments against invoices and payment matches, writes to reconciled and payments tables, and initiates the monthly report build.
